question: Who should perform piercing initiation and by what ascending process does it work?
premises: Piercing initiation has been explained in many ways in various places.
It should be performed by one who has practice.
Its effect proceeds through higher and higher entry.
inference: Effective piercing initiation requires an experienced practitioner and unfolds as a progressive ascent.
plain_english: Piercing initiation has been explained in many ways in various places. It should be performed by one who has practice, so that entry proceeds higher and higher.
